description: Update the survey questions and respondent-info settings for a recorder.

consent.description: Consent screen: { isEnabled, title, description, yesButtonLabel, noButtonLabel, isRequired, fieldId? }

email.description: Whether to collect the respondent's email

name.description: Whether to collect the respondent's name

questions.description: Survey questions. Each: { question, isRequired, answerType, options?, includeOther?, fieldId? }. answerType must be one of: "single", "multiple", "checkbox", "radiobutton", "dropdownlist", "date", "time", "datetime". Choice types (single, multiple, checkbox, radiobutton, dropdownlist) take options:string[] and includeOther:boolean (adds a free-text "Other"). date/time/datetime take no options. There is no free-text/rating/number answerType. (id? may also be passed to update an existing question.)

name: update_recorder_questions

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Update Recorder Questions
